notes: *no further*: the negative takes *no* and `יָסַף` takes *further* as part of its own *will proceed ... further* recasting; fusing *no further* onto `לֹא` would leave the verb's repetition sense unrendered, so rule 35's split case governs.
The three waws take *and*, *Yea* and *but* respectively, read off the ASV under rule 14.
